newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Albright says Ross trip not decided.
newsitem.headline: Albright says Ross trip not decided.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright said on Tuesday she was assessing when to send mediator Dennis Ross back to the Middle East after Israel and the Palestinians agreed on a partial resumption of their peace talks.
"Dennis is always prepared to go...We're assesing what the appropriate time for him to go is," she told reporters during a visit to Singapore.
The United States is "encouraged by the fact that they are going to be talking. We're going to have to how it proceeds", she added.
Israel and Palestinians on Monday announced the partial resumption of their talks which had been deadlocked for four months.

While the first hint of diplomatic movement since the talks ground to a halt last March, the decision was a modest one. The two sides have only agreed to talk about the list of mutual promises already made and not kept.

Israel has accused the Palestinians of breaching promises to control violence against the Jewish state while Palestinians opposed Israeli efforts to build new settlements in Arab east jerusalem, arguing this contravened the 1993 Oslo peace accords.
